description: Official validation response of HC param-MAE and MRE to a centroid-preserving scale on the 4 HC landmarks. All three submissions share the identical base (v19 = submission/full_family_postdrop_seed42), with the 8 non-HC tasks byte-identical, so each row is a clean single-variable A/B.

local_out_of_sample_fit.note: the local harness under-estimates the required shrink; the organisers' own annotations shift the optimum

verdict: optimum is at or below 0.950 but the curve is a flat basin: step 1.000->0.975 gained 15.647 HC param-MAE, step 0.975->0.950 only 0.798. Recommend settling at 0.950; a further probe at 0.90 would likely return under 0.3.
